_comment: Copy to st-config.json on the player's storage root. Absent or 0 means this device does NOT run a server - which is the default, because exactly one box per site should host one.
_payloadUrl: Where the server package comes from. REQUIRED — there is no vendor default: point this at your own host (e.g. https://example.com/scripts/server-payload.zip) so a site never reaches across the internet to someone else's server to update software running on its own hardware. The launcher reads <payloadUrl with .zip swapped for .json> to learn what version is published, so both files must sit together. Leave empty to disable update checks.
_autoUpdate: true (default) checks that manifest on every boot and installs a different version. Set false to pin this box to whatever it already has. A failed check or a failed update NEVER stops the installed server from starting.
_updateCheckHours: How often a RUNNING box asks whether a newer payload has been published. 24 by default; 0 checks only at boot. The check downloads the small manifest, not the package. When something new is published the box REBOOTS so the boot path installs it - the server runs inside the launcher process, so it cannot be replaced underneath itself. Each published payload is worth exactly one reboot: if the install does not take, the box stays where it is and says so in .payload-install.log rather than rebooting every day. autoUpdate:false disables this regardless of the value here.
